data.title: Zscaler Earns Buy Rating as CrowdStrike Acquisition and Strong Results Drive Price Target to $278
data.description:
D.A. Davidson analyst Rudy Kessinger has maintained their bullish stance on ZS stock, giving a Buy rating today.

Rudy Kessinger has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, led by CrowdStrike’s announced acquisition of Zscaler and his expectation that the transaction will close. Because Zscaler shareholders are set to receive 1.135 CrowdStrike shares per share, he expects ZS to move toward the implied deal value as completion approaches. His existing Buy view on CrowdStrike therefore supports a more favorable stance on Zscaler.

He also considered Zscaler’s first-quarter results constructive, including $949.3 million in revenue, $230.2 million in operating profit, and $1.23 in earnings per share. Reported net new annual recurring revenue of $111 million exceeded consensus, although the analyst noted that the contribution from Red Canary made organic growth less certain. Kessinger raised the price target from $215 to $278, linking it to his $245 CrowdStrike target and valuing Zscaler at 10 times expected fiscal 2028 revenue or 40 times expected free cash flow.

According to TipRanks, Kessinger is a 5-star analyst with an average return of 15.3% and a 56.58% success rate. Kessinger covers the Technology sector, focusing on stocks such as Akamai, Palo Alto Networks, and MongoDB.

In another report released today, Bernstein also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $298.00 price target.

data.title: Gens Aurea: Strong Growth, Store Expansion and Attractive Valuation Support €17 Target
data.description:
Gens Aurea S.p.A., the Consumer Cyclical sector company, was revisited by a Wall Street analyst on November 19. Analyst Andrea Zampaloni from Alantra Equities reiterated a Buy rating on the stock and has a €17.00 price target.

Andrea Zampaloni gave his rating based on several factors, including Gens Aurea’s strong third-quarter sales growth despite heat-related footfall weakness and lower gold prices. Buy-Sell activity and regional results indicated further market-share gains, while resilient gross margins supported earnings quality. The faster store rollout, with 581 locations already operating and further openings planned, provides a clear foundation for continued expansion.
Cash generation remained healthy despite taxes, IPO expenses and working-capital needs, and the first interim dividend signals management’s commitment to shareholder returns. Confirmed profit guidance, ongoing double-digit trading growth and potential working-capital benefits support confidence in the outlook. At 4.5x expected FY27 EV/EBITDA and 7.2x forward P/E, the shares appear attractively valued, with the €17 target implying substantial upside from the current price.

data.title: Sa Sa’s Profitability Rebounds on Strong Sales and Cost Control; Buy Rating Maintained with HKD1.69 Price Target Unchanged
data.description:
In a report released on November 20, Mavis Hui from DBS reiterated a Buy rating on Sa Sa International Holdings Limited, with a price target of HK$1.69.

Mavis Hui gave her Buy rating based on Sa Sa’s strong first-half FY27 performance, with revenue growth, a richer exclusive-brand mix and tighter cost control driving a sharp improvement in profitability. Hong Kong and Macao benefited from rising tourist spending and store productivity, while Southeast Asia improved and Mainland China’s reduced low-margin B2B exposure supported regional earnings quality.

The positive outlook is reinforced by accelerating sales in October and mid-November, rapid payback from new stores, and a debt-free balance sheet with ample liquidity to fund expansion. With the shares trading at about 11x forward earnings and offering a dividend yield above 6.4%, Hui views the risk-reward as attractive and maintains the unchanged HKD1.69 price target.
